parameters.content:
## Lever Job Board Postings by Company Slug

**Actor:** [Lever Job Board Postings by Company Slug](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/lever-job-board-postings-by-company-slug)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/lever-job-board-postings-by-company-slug.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `companySlugs` (array)
- `companySlug` (string)
- `postingIds` (array)
- `boardRegion` (string)
- `team` (string)
- `department` (string)
- `location` (string)
- `commitment` (string)
- `workplaceType` (string)
- `remoteOnly` (boolean)
- `country` (string)

### Output fields
- `title` (Title)
- `companySlug` (Company Slug)
- `location` (Location)
- `workplaceType` (Workplace Type)
- `employmentType` (Employment Type)
- `salaryText` (Salary Text)
- `createdAt` (Created At)
- `hostedUrl` (Hosted Url)

description: Lever job board postings: runs the Lever Job Board Postings by Company Slug Apify Actor, returns title, companySlug, location, salaryText, createdAt and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
